text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since introducing the shrine's 
origins, 
No Reason threw herself into community 
activities, 
skyrocketing her fame across the local 
area.

text_block_list.name: Local TV Reporter
text_block_list.text:
—And now, No Reason-san! How do you find 
the sweets from this shop?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, quite pleasing to my palate! 
I hereby bestow upon them the honor of 
'Peerless Under Heaven'!
choice_data_list:
(...She's basically turned into a local 
celebrity.)

text_block_list.name: Local Townsfolk
text_block_list.text:
["Man oh man, having No Reason-chan visit 
is fantastic publicity!" 
"I sure hope she stops by our shop 
next..."]

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Umu, umu! Leave it unto me, and this land 
is guaranteed 
prosperity, free trade, and peace under 
heaven! 
Nyahahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Priest
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me... No Reason-san. 
About the shrine, there's something I'd 
like to discuss...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, it slipped my mind! 
Fret not, I shall drop by later, so await 
me!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Now then. Here lies the linchpin of our 
stratagem. 
Just as we rehearsed, Strategist.
choice_data_list: ...I'm nervous... in more ways than one.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Priest
text_block_list.text:
...No Reason-san hardly comes by here 
lately. 
And in the end, what was that "stratagem" 
she mentioned back then—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Priest
text_block_list.text:
No. I can't rely on others forever. 
I have to step up myself—huh?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the wait! 
I have been dreadfully occupied of late!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Strategist. Present our future 
blueprint unto her. 
Kukuku...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Priest
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-What on earth is this...?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It came to me in a flash! What truly 
belongs upon this prime 
real estate overlooking the town—is not a 
mere "shrine." 
Nay, it is a "CASTLE"!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Therefore! Upon this hill shall rise a 
gargantuan new tourism stronghold: 
named none other than 'Castle No Reason'!!
choice_data_list:
And negotiations with all relevant parties 
are already complete!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And atop the castle keep shall loom a 
grand golden statue 
of No Reason! Gazing down over this land 
for all eternity! 
Gwahahaha, hahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Priest
text_block_list.text:
A c-castle...?! Wait, hold on, what about 
the shrine?! 
You can't be serious...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nay, I have realized the truth! No longer 
does this place hold 
the power to unite horsegirls and mankind! 
Thus, we have no choice but to forge a new 
symbol!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Priest
text_block_list.text:
Th-That isn't true at all! 
This shrine has watched over the people of 
this land for centuries...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I foresaw that thou wouldst resist. 
—Hence, I have devised a delightfully 
fitting contest.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Thou recallest how I reenacted history 
prior, yes? 
The historical tale of carrying the 
shrine's cornerstone to the summit.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
This time, you and I shall reenact it! 
We each haul a boulder in place of a 
foundation stone, 
and whoever reaches this ground first 
claims victory!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Of course, we'll draw a crowd and 
livestream the event! 
It shall serve as splendid publicity for 
our grand castle! 
Nyahahaha!!
choice_data_list:
Naturally, you're free to decline if 
you're not up for it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
I... I'll do it! 
I will... protect this shrine!!

text_block_list.name: Murmuring Locals
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hey... is it true they're building a 
castle over the shrine? 
Sure, it might bring tourists, but..." 
"Yeah, what's gonna happen to our 
shrine...?"

text_block_list.name: Local Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
A castle, huh... What do you think? 
If that shrine really disappeared...

text_block_list.name: Local Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: ...Well... I guess... I'd miss it a lot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the contest began... 
Yet the disparity in strength between No 
Reason and the priestess was stark. 
Right from the start, the gap began to 
widen.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... S-So heavy...! 
Ngh, but... I can't afford to lose...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, what's the matter, what's the 
matter?! 
Your feet have ground completely to a 
halt!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Is your conviction truly so feeble?! 
If that's the best you've got, Castle No 
Reason's construction is as good as 
decided! 
Bwahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Local Child
text_block_list.text:
P-Priestess! Don't give up! 
You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
I... I can't... collapse here...! 
The symbol... of our town's bonds...!

text_block_list.name: Locals
text_block_list.text:
"Ngh... I can't just stand by and watch 
this!" 
"Hey! Hold on, I'll lend you a hand!"

text_block_list.name: Local TV Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's this?! The local residents have 
stepped in to support 
the struggling priestess, marching 
alongside her?! 
Could this be—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho?! Wh-What's this...? 
Is this not the very legend of the 
shrine's founding unfolding before our 
eyes?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Long ago, when the shrine's foundation 
stones were being hauled... 
It was the Umamusume who volunteered for 
the arduous task, 
only for their bodies to be pushed to 
their limits beneath the crushing weight!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yet, that shrine stood as the beacon of 
peace for all who dwelt here! 
They could not falter...! And just as 
their legs were about to buckle beneath 
their indomitable will—!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It was the humans who stepped forward to 
aid them, rally them, 
and shoulder those foundation stones 
together!

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
Aye... that's the very tale my grandfather 
told me long ago! 
That is why that shrine is the sacred bond 
uniting Umamusume and humans—all who live 
upon this land!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Guh! But... what good is some dusty old 
legend?! 
It won't make you a single red cent!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, make your choice, townsfolk! Will you 
aid me and claim prosperity?! 
Or will you cling to the so-called 'bonds' 
of this backwater land?!

text_block_list.name: Locals
text_block_list.text:
"Ngh...!" "We..." 
"Well, of course... there's only one 
answer!"

text_block_list.name: Locals
text_block_list.text:
"We choose our bonds, 
every damn day of the weeeek!!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The priestess, bolstered by the 
townspeople, versus No Reason, pushing 
forward entirely alone. 
At the end of their fierce struggle, 
victory went to the former.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Th-Thank you so much, 
everyone... On my own, I never could have 
made it this far—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
S-So, how about that, No Reason?! 
It might not have been strictly fair by 
the rules, but... 
this is the true testament to the bond 
between humans and Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? No Reason? 
Wh-Where did she go...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well, it took quite a roundabout 
stratagem, 
but rolling up our sleeves proved well 
worth the trouble.
choice_data_list:
Even if we ended up playing the complete 
villains.

Even if we ended up playing the complete 
villains.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nwahaha, ruthless means for a merciful 
end, as they say. 
...Either way, we've no more need to 
worry.
